[[File:Keshtah.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The Tapani River, in southern Keshtah Minor]]
The '''Tapani River''' was a [[river]] in southern part of [[Keshtah Minor]], a continent on the planet [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. It was presumably named after the [[Tapani]] ancestors of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], who ruled the planet Kesh. It had been explored and cataloged by the Lost Tribe of Sith by [[4975 BBY]].
